sara-marketing: Quick ask — for the webinar live demo we need a benchmark pack that proves repeatability and graceful degradation. Specifically: coldstart vs warmed KV-cache, single-user interactive latency, a burst profile (50 concurrent simulated users), and a steady high-rps profile. Also include embedding+rerank path used in the demo and deterministic RNG seeds so marketing can reproduce outputs. Need p50/p90/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost estimate (tokens -> $), raw request/response payloads, and failure traces. Target: 48h. @kai-runtime can you take point?

kai-runtime: I can run this. Clarifying: which model variants? e.g., hero-7b:q4_0 and hero-7b:fp16? Hosted vs Dedicated comparisons? And you want exact same inputs + RNG seed pinned?

sara-marketing: Pin seeds. Please include hero-7b:q4_0 and openchat-13b:fp16. We want hosted (public API) and one Dedicated-like run (reserved pool sim). Use same batch sizes as demo (1 for interactive, 16 for embeddings). Attached are three canonical payload types we'll use: short chat, long-context summarization, and embedding rerank.

---payloads (summary)---
chat generation: pinned model, messages with system+user, max_tokens 120, temperature 0.7
embedding: embed-small-v1, inputs array, top_k 5, batch 16

benji-engineering: For bench harness we'll run three sweeps: 1) single-user interactive steady for 15m — measure coldstart and warmed p99; 2) burst 50 concurrent users (10s bursts every 30s for 20m) — capture tail latencies and error rates; 3) sustained throughput 200 rps for 30m to check queue/backpressure. Include warmup script that replays demo sequence to populate KV caches. Example: ./bench-runner --config webinar-stability.yaml --sweep single,burst,sustained --artifacts /tmp/webinar-1807654321. Expose exact env/config so marketing can replay locally.

kai-runtime: Will pin RNG via header x-rng-seed and attach README with env vars and warmup sequence. Hosted run uses API key route; Dedicated-like run uses reserved endpoint. Note: q4 quantized paths may diverge on non-deterministic kernels; we'll document diffs and include example diffs.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: run/bench/webinar-stability/1807654321 — started. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/1807654321/logs

kai-runtime: Running sweeps now. ETA initial artifacts ~12h, full artifact pack (raw requests/responses, p95/p99 tables, warmup script, reproducibility notes, diff examples) in ~36h. Will include CSV with per-run seed values and reproducible command lines. Recommend demo fallback: fallback to hero-3b when p99 > 2s for interactive route.

olivia-product: That fallback policy is great — we'll call out graceful degradation on the slide. Please also include a one-sentence blurb comparing hosted vs dedicated on tail latency and cost for the webinar.

sara-marketing: Please drop artifact bundle to /shared/marketing/benchpacks/webinar-1807654321 and @mention me when ready. If any run shows >0.5% error rate on burst sweep, flag it so we can decide demo throttles. Thanks! :raised_hands:

kai-runtime: Will do. Posting interim numbers to this thread and uploading full pack when done.
